# Theme Template Library

Welcome to the EComposer development documentation!

EComposer lets theme developers build pages and sections visually, then ship them as a **template library** inside their theme. Merchants who use your theme can pick these templates directly in the EComposer app.

With a template library you can:

- Build polished, responsive pages and sections without advanced coding.
- Update your library at any time, so your theme stays up to date.
- Give merchants a ready-made starting point that matches your theme.

## 5 steps to build a theme library

1. Install the EComposer app on your Shopify store.
2. Build your first page or section.
3. Export it as a file (**Save as file** in the top bar).
4. Create an `ecomposer.json` file in your theme's **assets** folder (structure below).
5. Upload your exported files to the same **assets** folder.

## Set up your theme

The Shopify theme code editor only allows certain file types in each folder, so library files go in the **assets** folder.

1. In your Shopify admin, go to **Online Store**, click the three dots (**...**) and select **Edit code**.

   <img src="/theme-editor.png" alt="Open the theme code editor" />

2. Expand the **assets** folder and click **Add a new asset**.
3. Extract the zip file below and upload all its files to your theme.

   <img src="/upload-assets.png" alt="Upload files to the assets folder" />

## `ecomposer.json` structure

> The comments below are for explanation only. Remove them in your real file, because JSON does not allow comments.

```jsonc
{
  "author": "Kalles",
  "logo": "https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0332/6420/5963/files/kalles.svg",
  "website": "https://your-site.com?utm_source=ecomposer",
  "library": {
    // Categories used to group pages and sections
    "categories": [
      { "id": "landing", "title": "Landing" },
      { "id": "home", "title": "Home" }
    ],

    "pages": [
      {
        "title": "The first page",
        // File name in the assets folder, or a full URL
        // e.g. "https://domain.com/folder/CqpElqxn3v.jpg"
        "thumbnail": "CqpElqxn3v.jpg",
        "categories": ["home"],
        // Your file exported from EComposer, uploaded to the assets folder
        // You can also use a full URL
        // e.g. "https://domain.com/folder/MyTemplate.ecom"
        "source": "MyTemplate.ecom"
      }
      // ...more pages
    ],

    "sections": [
      {
        "title": "The first section",
        "thumbnail": "https://dev.ecompoer.app/storage/elements-public/posts/pages/thumbnails/1011/2021/11/17/CqpElqxn3v.jpg",
        "categories": ["landing", "home"],
        // Your file exported from EComposer, uploaded to the assets folder
        // You can also use a full URL
        // e.g. "https://domain.com/folder/MySection.ecom"
        "source": "MySection.ecom"
      }
      // ...more sections
    ]
  }
}
```

### Fields

| Field        | Description                                                                 |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `author`     | Your name or brand name.                                                    |
| `logo`       | URL of your logo.                                                           |
| `website`    | URL of your website.                                                        |
| `categories` | List of categories (`id` + `title`). Pages and sections refer to the `id`.  |
| `title`      | Name of the page or section.                                                |
| `thumbnail`  | Preview image. Use a file name in the assets folder or a full URL.          |
| `source`     | The `.ecom` file you exported. Use a file name in the assets folder or a URL.|
